scripts.relay: bun run build:web && cd relay && npx wrangler dev --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8787
scripts.deploy:relay: bun run build:web && cd relay && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: cd agent && bunx tsc --noEmit && cd ../relay && bunx tsc --noEmit && cd ../web && bunx tsc --noEmit
scripts.ios:check: cd ios/ErrandKit && swift build && cd ../.. && bun ios/scripts/interop.ts gen /tmp/errand-vectors.json && ios/ErrandKit/.build/debug/InteropCheck /tmp/errand-vectors.json /tmp/errand-reply.json && bun ios/scripts/interop.ts verify /tmp/errand-vectors.json /tmp/errand-reply.json
